data.one_liner: A collection of performance-oriented tools, widgets, stream helpers, and numeric types.
data.what_it_does: Provides a variety of utility classes, custom widgets like FluentListView and AsyncBuilder, stream extensions and subjects, numeric type representations, and caching management tools.
use_when: You need custom stream subjects and stream extensions for RxDart integration.
You want helper widgets like FluentListView or AsyncBuilder.
You require lightweight caching and lazy initialization utilities.
avoid_when: You only need a single standard utility like uuid or crypto.
You prefer keeping your dependencies minimal and do not need a broad collection of disparate tools.
strengths: Comprehensive collection of reactive and async extensions.
Includes performance-oriented caching and collection tools.
Provides helpful widget builders out of the box.
weaknesses: Large surface area with many unrelated utilities bundled into one package.
Some niche features might overlap with existing focused packages.
